description: Review the locale changes in the current git diff (working tree vs HEAD, including untracked files) or vs a base ref, e.g. before committing or in a PR. QAs only the changed entries with the same checks as babelize_check (missing keys, placeholders, ICU, plural forms, untranslated, glossary from .babelize/config.json), and flags source strings whose translations were not updated (stale) and new source keys a locale is missing. Read-only; no network, no API key.

base.description: Branch, tag or commit to compare with (default HEAD, i.e. uncommitted changes), e.g. "main" or "origin/main".

path.description: Project directory, relative to the workspace root (default: the workspace root). Must stay inside the workspace.

name: babelize_review
title: Review locale changes in a diff
